fact.title: Mercy University - International Student Fast Facts (2026-2027 costs, scholarships)

cat.title: Mercy University Undergraduate Catalog - Undergraduate Admissions

test_policy.notes: SAT/ACT are not required for international undergraduates (required for traditional Nursing and some specialized programs and for NCAA Division II athletes); scores may be submitted for consideration. An SAT Critical Reading score of 500+ is one of the English-waiver routes.

requirements.notes: Apply through the Common App or mercy.edu; $40 non-refundable fee (undergraduate catalog). Foreign transcripts need a course-by-course credential evaluation from a NACES/AICE member (waived for some programs). Music Production and Recording, Nursing, Pre-Occupational Therapy Assistant and Veterinary Technology need supplemental documents. International enrollment deposit $400 commuter / $500 resident, refundable if the F-1 visa is denied.

deadlines.label: Rolling admission (fall 2027 entry); no application deadline published
deadlines.notes: Mercy admits on a rolling basis. First-time F-1 applicants are asked to submit documents and the I-20 request at least 60 days before the term starts (30 days for U.S. F-1 transfers). No priority date is listed.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waived for citizens of listed English-speaking countries (e.g. Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia, Singapore, South Africa), two years of regular English at a U.S. high school, an American GED, 12+ U.S. college credits (2.0 GPA), SAT Critical Reading 500+, AP English 3+, IB English B SL 4+, Cambridge English 160+, GTEC 1,140+, or B2 on the CEFR through an approved school. Conditional admission (bachelor's only): applicants below the minimum can finish ESL at Oxford International - New York (Manhattan) or other approved schools (EF, ELS, EC) to B2 CEFR, and the TOEFL/IELTS requirement is then met; Mercy also runs a University Pathway Program with Oxford International.

Exams on or after 2026-01-21; the page lists '4' without naming the 1-6 scale.
Undergraduate minimum on the current page (an older Mercy page listed 100).
Listed as a waiver, not a test option: B2 First, C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency with 160+ waives the English requirement for undergraduates.

cost.notes: International fact sheet, cost of attendance per year (2026-2027): undergraduate tuition $23,550; room and board, double occupancy, $16,130 at the Westchester campus ($17,500 at the New York City campus). Required fees are not given

aid.notes: Fact sheet: undergraduate academic merit scholarships of $4,000-$10,000 per year for freshman applicants ($3,000-$8,000 for transfers). The international page says all incoming full-time freshmen and transfers are automatically reviewed based on academic standing. International students are not eligible for federal or state aid; institutional need-based aid for them is not described.
